mapper.select: SELECT * FROM BLOG ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO blog (title, content, writer, username, img, book_title, book_author, book_publisher, book_rating, created_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{writer}, #{username}, #{img}, #{bookTitle}, #{bookAuthor}, #{bookPublisher}, #{bookRating}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, writer, username, img, book_title as bookTitle, book_author as bookAuthor, book_publisher as bookPublisher, book_rating as bookRating, created_at as createdAt FROM blog WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE BLOG SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, img = #{img}, book_title = #{bookTitle}, book_author = #{bookAuthor}, book_publisher = #{bookPublisher}, book_rating = #{bookRating} WHERE id = #{id}
